_about: Startup JS + CSS budget of index.html in bytes, checked by tools/check-size.js (definition in its header). 2.0 was 1,569,203 bytes; 2.1 adds 11,962 (the import progress through every step, the report's collapse and toggle, the version beside the name, their strings and icons): 1,581,165, rounded up to the next 5 kB. 2.3 adds the Settings choice for cells merged over rows and the Word / HTML importer's filled-out table grid: 1,584,772, within the same budget. The PDF importer loads on demand; the builders (PowerPoint included) still load at startup — loading them on first use (TODO.md, High) lowers it. 2.4: raised to 1,595,000 (+10 KB, the owner's decision, 2026-11-09) for the page items of 2.4 — the tagline's icon, the export buttons by mode, the Word settings header, the slide-format check (its rules loaded only on switching to slides); 2.3 had left 82 bytes. Then 1,600,000 (+5 KB, the owner's decision, 2026-11-09) for the slides preview's progress bar (PptxBuilder's progress and chunked layout, the bar, its words): the slides view loads with the page, so nothing of it could load on demand — loading the whole slides view on demand is planned for 2.5. Then 1,601,000 (+1 KB, the owner's offer, 2026-11-09): one progress window across the app — the slides preview's progress moves into the task window, shown without making it modal (a task takes it over); the in-pane bar's markup and styles go. 2.5: 1,602,500 (+1.5 KB, asked of the owner with this pull request, 2026-11-09) for the slide check after a paste or an import in Slides and before a PPTX export: its hooks in the editor, the importer, the exporter and the Slides view (the check, its words and its report stay in scripts/slidecheck.js, loaded on demand).
